shortDescription: Track a code or infrastructure change as a PagerDuty change event

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment name, typically V(production), V(staging), and so on.

options.name: integration_key
options.description: The integration key that identifies the service the change was made to. This can be found by adding an integration to a service in PagerDuty.

options.name: link_text
options.description: Descriptive text for a URL where more information about the deployment can be obtained.

options.name: link_url
options.description: A URL where more information about the deployment can be obtained.

options.name: repo
options.description: The URL of the project repository.

options.name: revision
options.description: An identifier of the revision being deployed, typically a number or SHA from a version control system.

options.name: source
options.description: The source of the change event.

options.name: summary
options.description: A short description of the change that occurred.

options.name: url
options.description: URL to submit the change event to.

options.name: user
options.description: The name of the user or process that triggered this deployment.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates for the target URL are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
